name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32C5
description: First XIAO with dual-band 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi 6: ESP32-C5 with 8 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, BLE 5, 802.15.4 (Thread/Zigbee) and battery charging.
notes: JTAG, battery-voltage and reset/boot pads are on the back; 11 GPIO on the side pads, 5 ADC channels, 2 UART, 1 I2C, 1 SPI.
External antenna via U.FL (FPC antenna included).
Sold un-soldered ($6.90) or pre-soldered ($7.99). Very new: check library/toolchain support.
Standard 14-pad XIAO footprint (7 per side, 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm row spacing); header coordinates assume the pads are centred on the 21 mm board length.
